name: Kirihara Megumu
source: [url=/c23355]Saki's[/url] older sister. Megumu has a very serious and stubborn personality. She originally went to another school, but then transferred to Luitos Academy. When she was younger, Megumu used to admire the protagonist, but after her father passed out she started acting coldly towards him.
